summary.text: Heather Surprenant, a Democrat from Barnard, represented Windsor-4 in the Vermont House of Representatives from 2021 until she resigned on September 29, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Surprenant was raised in Randolph, Vermont, and earned a BA in government from Smith College, according to her House biography.
After graduating she moved to San Francisco for human rights work, interning with the Women's Economic Agenda Project in Oakland.
She then worked at an organic farm in Half Moon Bay, California, before returning to Vermont to continue farming.
At the time of her biography she managed the organic vegetable operation at Kiss the Cow Farm and, in the winter months, worked as a dairy farmer there.
